last_handoff: 2026-09-20, late. Three rounds shipped and verified on production; the pixel round closed last. (1) PostHog REVERSE PROXY (laws 8.39). (2) SIGNUPS MEASURABLE (laws 8.40 a-j): purchase_confirmed sent SERVER-side from the Razorpay webhook, campaign attribution surviving the apex-to-store hop in a first-party kh_utm cookie. (3) META PIXEL MIGRATION (laws 8.41 a-i). THE PIXEL IS CORRECTLY INSTALLED: one pixel initialises on each host, ViewContent fires on /products/kheelu, the allow list, first-party cookies and automatic advanced matching are on, all three 'automatic' toggles are off, Diagnostics is clean. THE ROUND'S TWO LASTING LAWS ARE BOTH ABOUT INSTRUMENTS. 8.41-h: the pixel sends through an element created with createElement, so the resource timeline, the extension network panel AND hooks on fetch/sendBeacon/XHR/new Image() ALL read zero while it works; only HTMLImageElement.prototype.src catches it. fbq also DE-DUPLICATES a repeated PageView within one page load, so re-firing one proves nothing, and eventCount is the cheap honest check (1 ordinary, 2 on /products/kheelu). 8.41-i: META ITSELF MIRRORS BROWSER EVENTS INTO THE SERVER CHANNEL, to every dataset connected to the business-level Conversions API. An hourly CSV export showed server_received_count tracking browser_received_count 1:1 while this app sends only Purchase server-side. That, not stale code, is what kept the RETIRED pixel receiving after its own integrations were removed; the founder excluded dataset 1045085251085243 at 23:32 and connected is now 1. GENERAL LAW, third costume of 8.34-f / 8.38-i / 8.41-g: an absence measured by the wrong instrument is not an absence - build the control first. OPEN AND FOUNDER-OWNED: (a) the rotated CAPI token has never carried a real order, so its validity is UNPROVEN - Purchase with connection method 'Multiple' means it works, 'Browser' only plus [meta-capi] REJECTED in the Vercel log means one more token and no code change; (b) CHECK TOMORROW that the old pixel's 'last received' keeps ageing and never resets, because the same-session check was inconclusive and is recorded as such; (c) re-tag the Meta ads (utm_source=facebook plus placement={{placement}}) and rename campaigns to -; (d) re-check the new pixel's 'Websites' panel after a day of real traffic. NOTE 'Automatically connect only your datasets' is ON, so a NEW pixel in this portfolio would start mirroring immediately - and always cite the PAGE when naming a Meta setting, because that name collides with 'Automatically include more detailed page and product info' on the pixel's own Settings page, which is correctly Off.
